senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָתַם)seal, stamp, die; enclosure locked up with a mark.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> <he>כח׳ המרצופין</he> as much sealing clay as required for a seal on bags.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ האיגרות</he> seal on letters.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:5">Snh. IV, 5</cite> <he>אדם טובע … בח׳ אחד</he> a human being prints many coins from one die &c., but the Lord <he>טבע … בחוֹתָמוֹ של וכ׳</he> stamped every human being with the die of Adam, and yet not one is like the other; Y. ib. IV, 22ᵇ bot. <he>מח׳ וכ׳</he>.
Sabb. 58ᵃ העבד בח׳ שבצוארו the slave with the mark hanging down from his neck, בח׳ שבכסותו with the mark tied to his garment; a. fr.—Trnsf. sexual innocence; purity.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 766">Yalk. Num. 766</cite>, v. infra.—Pl. <he>חוֹתָמוֹת</he>, <he>חוֹתָמִים</he>. Y. Snh. l. c.—

<cite ref="Beitzah 31b:10">Bets. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ שבקרקע וכ׳</he> knots which serve as marks on doors of subterranean stores, may be untied &c.; a. e.—Tan. d’be El. ch. XX, <he>בחוֹתָמֵיהֶן</he> in their innocence.

senses.gloss: [lock,] the oblate side of a berry to which the stalk is attached.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:3:2">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 10:5">Toh. X, 5</cite> <he>גרגר … ח׳</he> a single berry, if its oblate part with the stalk is intact; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:10">Tosef. ib. XI, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:10">Ib.</cite> <he>מקום ח׳</he> the place where the stalk (now torn out) was seated (and where now juice is oozing out).

senses.gloss: the membraneous enclosure separating the stone of a date from its flesh, pericarp (as far as not eatable).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 1:23">Tosef. Ḥull. I, 23</cite> <he>הח׳ טמא ביבשה</he> quot. by R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:2">Ukts. II, 2</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>הח׳</he> omitted; oth. ed. <he>הזיתים</he> in place of the preceding <he>העמים</he>) the pericarp is counted in with the unclean matter in dry dates; Ukts. l. c. <he>ח׳ של יבשה</he> R. S. (ed. a. Maim. <cite ref="H00496"><he>חותל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:23">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חוֹתְמוֹתֵיהֶן</he>, v. <cite ref="H00902"><he>חִיתּוּם</he></cite>.
